title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE REGIONAL CULTURE PROMOTION ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE REGIONAL CULTURE PROMOTION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Regional Culture Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and matters necessary for their enforcement.

Article 2 (Application for Designation as an Institution for Fostering Specialized Human Resources for Regional Cultures) An application for designation as an institution for fostering specialized human resources for regional cultures under Article 7 (3) of the Enforcement Decree of the Regional Culture Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall use attached Form No. 1.

Article 3 (Certificate of Designation as an Institution for Fostering Specialized Human Resources for Regional Cultures) When the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism designates an institution for fostering specialized human resources for regional cultures pursuant to Article 10 (2) of the Regional Culture Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation as an institution for fostering specialized human resources for regional cultures in attached Form No. 2.

Article 4 (Certificate of Designation as a City of Culture) When the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism designates a city of culture pursuant to Article 15 (5) of the Act, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation as a city of culture in attached Form No. 3.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism No. 175, Jul. 29, 2014>

This Rule shall enter into force on July 29, 2014.

ADDENDUM (Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism Partially Amending 18 Statutes to Simplify Difficult Statutory Terminology) <Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism No. 371, Oct. 7, 2019>

This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
